expected=[[0,2,0,0,3,0,0,8,0],[2,2,2,3,3,3,8,8,8],[0,2,0,0,3,0,0,8,0]]
code='''def transform(grid):
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        crop = [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] == color else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        objects.append((c0, crop))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    height = max(len(crop) for _, crop in objects)
    width = sum(len(crop[0]) for _, crop in objects)
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    offset = 0
    for _, crop in objects:
        for r, row in enumerate(crop):
            for c, value in enumerate(row):
                out[r][offset + c] = value
        offset += len(crop[0])
    return out
'''
